[Absolutely, I will give you instant feedback. I will improve your pronunciation, grammar, everything, and you will start speaking very good English.] Speaker B: lekin tumse baat karna mahanga hoga na? [But talking to you will be expensive, right?] Speaker C: bilkul nahi. Normal English classes se 7 guna sasta hai. isliye ek crore log Speakeasy par English practice kar rahe hain. [Not at all. It is 7 times cheaper than normal English classes. That's why 1 crore people are practicing English on Speakeasy.] Speaker B: lekin time nahi milta. [But I don't get time.] Speaker C: roz sirf 15 se 20 minute practice kafi hai. tum aasani se confident ban jaogi. [Just 15 to 20 minutes of practice daily is enough. You will easily become confident.] Speaker B: Wow! kaise join karoon? [Wow! How do I join?] Speaker C: bas install ka button dabao aur Speakeasy app install karo. Sign up karo aur practice shuru karo. sirf 15 dino mein tumhe improvement dikhne lagega. chalo shuru karo. [Just press the install button and install the Speakeasy app. Sign up and start practicing. You will see improvement in just 15 days. Let's start.] Speaker D: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
